name: Gibel' satellitov
source:
Young witch Blake faces a tough choice: the army or education. Dying young doesn’t sound appealing, so she chooses the latter. The Royal Satellite Academy is an elite institution. The catch? Graduates become bodyguards to the royal family. A duty Blake has no desire to fulfill.

But graduation is still six long months away. Competition is fierce, and struggling students have a tendency to disappear. Can Blake survive long enough to uncover the truth behind the academy’s secrets, the hidden nature of the royal family and of magic itself?

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/15-1-0-3294]anivisual.net[/url]]
